title: FedADB: Class Anchor-Driven Dual-Branch Federated Learning for Mitigating Forgetting
abstract: arXiv:2608.15310v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal data collected by heterogeneous devices are used for collaborative training, where federated learning (FL) serves as a key paradigm for effective distributed modeling with data privacy preservation. However, local training suffers from the forgetting of previously learned global knowledge under cross-client data heterogeneity, which leads to significant declines in both performance and convergence speed. Most previous studies rely on global alignment strategies to retain global knowledge, which hinder local optimization and lead to inadequate supervision of missing classes. Some studies introduce proxy datasets to supplement supervision for missing classes. translated_title: FedADB：基于类别锚点驱动的双分支联邦学习以缓解遗忘
translated_abstract: 摘要：异构设备收集的多模态数据用于协作训练，其中联邦学习（FL）是有效分布式建模并保护数据隐私的关键范式。然而，在跨客户端数据异构性下，本地训练会遗忘先前学习的全局知识，导致性能和收敛速度显著下降。以往大多数研究依赖全局对齐策略来保留全局知识，但这阻碍了本地优化，并导致对缺失类别的监督不足。一些研究引入代理数据集来补充缺失类别的监督。然而，在没有代理数据集的情况下，平衡类别级全局一致性和本地优化目标仍然是一个挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了FedADB，一种基于类别锚点驱动的双分支联邦学习框架。具体而言，服务器生成优化后的类别锚点。
tldr: 本文提出FedADB框架，通过服务器生成优化的类别锚点驱动双分支学习，在无需代理数据集的情况下平衡类别级全局一致性与本地优化，从而有效缓解联邦学习中的遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedADB, a class anchor-driven dual-branch federated learning framework that balances class-wise global consistency and local optimization without proxy datasets, effectively mitigating forgetting in federated learning.
